headline: Is Hershey (HSY) A Bargain After Raised Outlook And Volume Weakness?
summary: Hershey stock has given investors a decline of about 16.3% over the past three years, yet the current checks send mixed signals, with an intrinsic value estimate suggesting upside while market multiples point to a richer price tag. Hershey shares are down 16.3% over three years, which puts extra focus on whether the current price still leaves room for a recovery in returns.
